items.body:
<details open>

[SYCL] add DPAS flash attention kernel for quantized KV cache (#31125)

* sycl : add DPAS flash attention kernel for quantized KV cache

Decode and small batches (1 to 31 query tokens) now run flash attention
straight on q4_0 and q8_0 KV blocks, instead of scalar dequant or
converting the whole cache to f16 per call. Q.K uses s8 x s4 and s8 x s8
DPAS on XMX, V.P stays f16. dpas.s4.s8 is inline vISA since joint_matrix
has no s4.

Covers head sizes 64 to 512, GQA up to 32 and attention sinks. Prompts
stay on the existing kernels. GGML_SYCL_FA_DPAS=0 turns it off.

B580, Llama 3.1 8B Q4_K_M, q4_0 KV, tg128: 31.3 to 54.2 t/s at 16K
context. FLASH_ATTN_EXT 4582/4584, same 2 failures as master.

Assisted-by: Claude

* sycl : 192 head dropped, Wildcat Lake added to docs

Assisted-by: Claude

* sycl : stricter checks from review

Assisted-by: Claude

* [SYCL] : rename XMX macro, add GGML_SYCL_SUPPORT_XMX option, document DPAS

Assisted-by: Claude

</details>

items.name: b11979
items.body:
<details open>

sycl : vectorize reordered-layout dequantization stores (Q4_0, K-quants, IQ3, MXFP4) (#30976)

* sycl : widen reordered q4_0 dequantization stores

The reordered-layout Q4_0 conversion kernel processed one qs byte per
work-item with two scalar stores, strided 16 elements apart. Give it
the same treatment the Q8_0 kernel got in #30775: a flat
sycl::range<1> launch with four qs bytes (8 outputs) per work-item
inside one 32-element block and two vec<dst_t,4> stores.

Same float math and rounding as the scalar kernel; output is
bit-identical. The existing k % QK4_0 == 0 assert guarantees whole
32-element blocks, so the k/8 launch covers every row exactly. The
now-unreferenced scalar reorder kernel is removed.

Arc Pro B70, primed prefill (prefill after decode on a
reorder-installed tensor): +6.4% to +7.3% pp512/pp2048 on Q4_0
models (tested up to 27B dense); fresh-layout prefill and decode
unchanged; PPL within run noise.

* sycl : vectorize reordered q4_K dequantization stores

The reordered-layout Q4_K conversion kernel already loads its
quantized inputs through sycl::vec but writes the dequantized
results with scalar stores. Build the results in a vec<dst_t,n>
register and emit two vector stores instead. Same per-element
math; output is bit-identical.

Arc Pro B70, primed prefill (prefill after decode on a
reorder-installed tensor): +14.7% to +15.3% pp512/pp2048 on
Q4_K-dominant models (tested up to 27B dense); fresh-layout
prefill, decode and PPL unchanged.

* sycl : remap reordered q5_K dequantization to vec4 loads/stores

The reordered-layout Q5_K conversion kernel gave each thread only
four outputs fed by scalar ql/qh byte loads plus a local-memory
scale broadcast, so the stores were never its bottleneck: widening
the stores alone measured within nois
